subject: Concept art of the Lancer, the player's light frigate in a sci-fi space war game: a small, fast, light warship about 6 meters long. Seen from directly above in a flat top-down orthographic plan view, its nose pointing straight up, centered, the whole ship visible with a wide empty margin around it, on a plain near-black background. A slim, compact, symmetrical hull with a clean silhouette that still reads at a small size: a pointed nose, short swept wings or fins, and engines at the back with glowing blue exhausts. Our team's color: light blue glowing strips and panels along the hull and wings, clearly visible from above. No gun turrets or cannons: at most one small, low hardpoint bump near the nose for its single weapon. Painted steel-gray armor plates with fine panel lines. Even, clear light so every part reads. No text or lettering anywhere.
style: Clean and neat: one object, whole and readable, on a plain background. Palette: background and dark surfaces in deep navy blacks (#0A0F16, #111722, #192130) and slate blues (#242D41, #3E4D6B); light in electric blue to pale cyan (#4E87BB, #71B2D8, #ACDBE9), the only bright accent; hulls and structures in cool steel grays (#686A79, #97999F). Crisp and sharp everywhere: clean hard edges, fine detail; no haze, no soft focus, no depth-of-field or motion blur. Realistic light, cinematic concept art. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no interface, no lens flares.
